71821-beyond-our-control.title: Beyond Our Control
71821-beyond-our-control.creator: Unknown
71821-beyond-our-control.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In Johannesburg, South Africa, the newly-elected President spoke in front of a TV camera. His dark, handsome face was coldly implacable as he said: "They wanted _apartheid_ when they were in power; we see no reason to believe they have changed their minds. They wanted _apartheid_--very well, they shall continue to have _apartheid_!"

arxiv-1806-11094.title: Quantum Anomalous Hall Phase Stabilized via Realistic Interactions on a Kagome Lattice
arxiv-1806-11094.creator: Yafei Ren, T.-S. Zeng, W. Zhu, D. N. Sheng
arxiv-1806-11094.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Yafei Ren, T.-S. Zeng, W. Zhu, D. N. Sheng. We study the quantum phases of spinless fermion at one-third filling on a Kagome lattice featuring a quadratic band touching Fermi point. In the presence of weak first and second nearest-neighbor repulsive interactions ( V 1 V_{1} and V 2 V_{2} ), we demonstrate an interaction driven quantum anomalous Hall effect by employing exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group methods. The time-reversal symmetry is broken spontaneously by forming loop currents that exhibit long-range correlation.

arxiv-1811-04632.title: Customisable X-ray fluorescence photodetector with submicron sensitivity using a ring array of silicon p-i-n diodes Journal: Scientific Reports 8 , 15926 (2018)
arxiv-1811-04632.creator: Phil S. Yoon
arxiv-1811-04632.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Phil S. Yoon. The research and development of silicon-based X X -ray fluorescence detectors achieved its submicron sensitivity. Its initial use is intended for in-situ beam monitoring at advanced light-source facilities. The effectively functioning prototype fully leveraged technologies and techniques from a wide array of scientific disciplines: X X -ray fluorescence technique, photon scattering and spectroscopy, astronomical photometry, semiconductor physics, materials science, microelectronics, analytical and numerical modelling, and high-performance computing.

arxiv-2205-12327.title: Beyond Impossibility: Balancing Sufficiency, Separation and Accuracy
arxiv-2205-12327.creator: Limor Gultchin, Vincent Cohen-Addad, Sophie Giffard-Roisin, Varun Kanade, Frederik Mallmann-Trenn
arxiv-2205-12327.description: Abstract Among the various aspects of algorithmic fairness studied in recent years, the tension between satisfying both sufficiency and separation – e.g. the ratios of positive or negative predictive values, and false positive or false negative rates across groups – has received much attention.

arxiv-2205-13795.title: Improving Item Cold-start Recommendation via Model-agnostic Conditional Variational Autoencoder Conference: Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2022; Madrid, Spain Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR
arxiv-2205-13795.creator: Xu Zhao, Yi Ren, Ying Du, Shenzheng Zhang, Nian Wang
arxiv-2205-13795.description: Abstract . Embedding & MLP has become a paradigm for modern large-scale recommendation system. However, this paradigm suffers from the cold-start problem which will seriously compromise the ecological health of recommendation systems. This paper attempts to tackle the item cold-start problem by generating enhanced warmed-up ID embeddings for cold items with historical data and limited interaction records.

arxiv-2311-02430.title: Fröberg’s Theorem, vertex splittability and higher independence complexes Thanks: Last updated: August 9, 2026
arxiv-2311-02430.creator: Priyavrat Deshpande, Amit Roy, Anurag Singh, Adam Van Tuyl
arxiv-2311-02430.description: Abstract . A celebrated theorem of Fröberg gives a complete combinatorial classification of quadratic square-free monomial ideals with a linear resolution. A generalization of this theorem to higher degree square-free monomial ideals is an active area of research. The existence of a linear resolution of such ideals often depends on the field over which the polynomial ring is defined.

arxiv-2406-06392.title: Tackling Delayed CSI in a Distributed Multi-Satellite MIMO Communication System
arxiv-2406-06392.creator: Yasaman Omid {\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0002-5739-8617}, Sangarapillai Lambotharan {\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0001-5255-7036}, Mahsa Derakhshani {\hrefhttps://orcid.org/0000-0001-6997-045X}
arxiv-2406-06392.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the integration of satellites with ground-based communication networks. Specifically, we analyze downlink data transmission from a constellation of satellites to terrestrial users and address the issue of delayed channel state information (CSI). The satellites cooperate in data transmission within a cluster to create a unified, distributed massive multiple input, multiple output (MIMO) system.

arxiv-2411-13884.title: Reinforcement Learning for Jointly Optimal Coding and Control Policies for a Controlled Markovian System over a Communication Channel Thanks: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada. The first and third authors are with the Department of Mathematics
arxiv-2411-13884.creator: Evelyn Hubbard, Liam Cregg, Serdar Yüksel
arxiv-2411-13884.description: Abstract We study the problem of joint optimization involving coding and control policies for a controlled Markovian system over a finite-rate noiseless communication channel. While structural results on the optimal encoding and control have been obtained in the literature, their implementation has been prohibitive in general, except for linear models.

arxiv-2504-17663.title: The Malicious Technical Ecosystem: Exposing Limitations in Technical Governance of AI-Generated Non-Consensual Intimate Images of Adults Conference: CHI’25 Sociotechnical AI Governance Workshop; April 2025; Yokohama, Japan
arxiv-2504-17663.creator: Michelle L. Ding, Harini Suresh
arxiv-2504-17663.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michelle L. Ding, Harini Suresh. In this paper, we adopt a survivor-centered approach to locate and dissect the role of sociotechnical AI governance in preventing AI-Generated Non-Consensual Intimate Images (AIG-NCII) of adults, colloquially known as “deep fake pornography.” We identify a “malicious technical ecosystem” or “MTE,” comprising of open-source face-swapping models and nearly 200 “nudifying” software programs that allow non-technical users to create AIG-NCII within minutes.

arxiv-2511-02331.title: RoME: Domain-Robust Mixture-of-Experts for MILP Solution Prediction across Domains
arxiv-2511-02331.creator: Tianle Pu, Zijie Geng, Haoyang Liu, Shixuan Liu, Jie Wang, Li Zeng, Chao Chen, Changjun Fan
arxiv-2511-02331.description: Abstract Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is a fundamental and powerful framework for modeling complex optimization problems across diverse domains. Recently, learning-based methods have shown great promise in accelerating MILP solvers by predicting high-quality solutions. However, most existing approaches are developed and evaluated in single-domain settings, limiting their ability to generalize to unseen problem distributions.

arxiv-2512-08738.title: Pose-Based Sign Language Spotting via an End-to-End Encoder Architecture
arxiv-2512-08738.creator: Samuel Ebimobowei Johnny, Blessed Guda, Emmanuel Enejo Aaron, Assane Gueye {sjohnny, blessedg, eaaron, assaneg}@andrew.cmu.edu
arxiv-2512-08738.description: Abstract Automatic Sign Language Recognition (ASLR) has emerged as a vital field for bridging the gap between deaf and hearing communities. However, the problem of sign-to-sign retrieval or detecting a specific sign within a sequence of continuous signs remains largely unexplored. We define this novel task as Sign Language Spotting.

arxiv-2601-15601.title: Overpartitions with repeated smallest non-overlined part
arxiv-2601-15601.creator: Amita Malik, Rishabh Sarma
arxiv-2601-15601.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Amita Malik, Rishabh Sarma. Inspired by Andrews’ and Bachraoui’s work on partitions with repeated smallest part, we extend the concept to overpartitions. Introduction In recent work [ 3 ] , Andrews and Bachraoui consider integer partitions whose smallest part is repeated exactly k -times and the remaining parts are distinct, denoted by \mathrm{spt}k_{d}(n) , and prove that their generating functions are linear combinations of the q -Pochhammer symbols with polynomials in q as coefficients. Let N,m,n be non-negative integers.

pmc-10573223.title: Effects of Cold Rolling Reduction Rate on the Microstructure and Properties of Cu-1.16Ni-0.36Cr Alloy after Thermo-Mechanical Treatment
pmc-10573223.creator: Wenming Sun, Shaolin Li, Kexing Song, Qiangsong Wang, Yingying Zhu
pmc-10573223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this paper, a Cu-Ni-Cr alloy was prepared by adding a Ni-Cr intermediate alloy to copper. The effects of the cold rolling reduction rate on the microstructure and properties of the Cu-1.16Ni-0.36Cr alloy after thermo-mechanical treatment were studied. The results show that the tensile strength of the alloy increased while the electrical conductivity slightly decreased with an increase of the cold rolling reduction rate. At a rolling strain of 3.2, the tensile strength was 512.0 MPa and the conductivity was 45.5% IACS.

pmc-11306633.title: Identification of genetic subtypes in follicular lymphoma
pmc-11306633.creator: Victoria Shelton, Rajesh Detroja, Ting Liu, Keren Isaev, Anjali Silva, Verena Passerini, Mehran Bakhtiari, Lourdes Calvente, Michael Hong, Michael Y He, Saloni Modi, Samantha A Hershenfeld, Maja Ludvigsen, Charlotte Madsen, Stephen Hamilton-Dutoit, Francesco Annibale d’Amore, Marianne Brodtkorb, Nat
pmc-11306633.description: Follicular lymphoma (FL) exhibits considerable variability in biological features and clinical trajectories across patients. To dissect the diversity of FL, we utilized a Bernoulli mixture model to identify genetic subtypes in 713 pre-treatment tumor tissue samples. Our analysis revealed the existence of five subtypes with unique genetic profiles that correlated with clinicopathological characteristics.

pmc-11433320.title: Developing a Cobalt Phosphide Catalyst with Combined Cobalt Defects and Phosphorus Vacancies to Boost Oxygen Evolution Reaction
pmc-11433320.creator: Weihua Ou, Ligui Li, Wei Zhou, Minzhe Chen, Chuheng Zhu, Xiaoyan Zhu, Ke Yuan, Alexey N Pestryakov
pmc-11433320.description: Defect engineering, by adjusting the surface charge and active sites of CoP catalysts, significantly enhances the efficiency of the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). We have developed a new Co1−xPv catalyst that has both cobalt defects and phosphorus vacancies, demonstrating excellent OER performance.

pmc-11676259.title: Spin-Density Wave, Unconventional Magnetic and Thermal Transport Properties in Sr2−x(PbCl2)xCu(BO3)2
pmc-11676259.creator: Dianta Ginting, Bora Won, Jong-Soo Rhyee
pmc-11676259.description: SrCu2(BO3)2 (Sr-122) has attracted considerable interest as a quasi-two-dimensional S = 1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnetic spin system with a Shastry-Sutherland lattice (SSL) structure. It features a Cu2+ spin dimer ground state and exhibits intra-dimer Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interactions, making Sr-122 a fascinating platform for studying quantum magnetic phenomena.

pmc-12428644.title: Parallel Neurological and Cardiac Progression in Hereditary Transthyretin Amyloidosis: An Integrated Clinical and Imaging Study
pmc-12428644.creator: Grazia Canciello, Stefano Tozza, Leopoldo Ordine, Brigida Napolitano, Giovanni Palumbo, Mariagiovanna Castiglia, Daniela Pacella, Raffaella Lombardi, Giovanni Esposito, Fiore Manganelli, Maria-Angela Losi
pmc-12428644.description: Background: Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) is a rare, autosomal dominant multisystem disease caused by pathogenic variants in the transthyretin (TTR) gene. Although ATTRv is classically categorized into “cardiac” and “neurologic” phenotypes, recent evidence suggests a more complex and overlapping disease spectrum.

pmc-12487892.title: Alloys with an exceptional combination of strength and ductility
pmc-12487892.creator: En Ma
pmc-12487892.description: Intelligently designed complex concentrated alloys achieve yield strength rivaling ultrahigh-strength steel and tensile ductility akin to unhardened elemental metal, synergistically reaching both coveted properties. Metals are the workhorse material for the manufacturing industry and structural applications. High strength is required to withstand service loads without yielding. Ductility allows ample safety margins against failure.

pmc-12612562.title: An enhanced deep learning-based framework for diagnosing apple leaf diseases
pmc-12612562.creator: Chhaya Gupta, Nasib Singh Gill, Preeti Gulia, Sangeeta Duhan, Hanen Karamti, Abhinav Kumar, Denekew Alemayehu Alamneh, Imen Safra
pmc-12612562.description: Timely and correct identification of diseases in the apple leaf is also important in protecting crop production and sustaining agriculture. This paper introduces E-YOLOv8, a lightweight improved version of YOLOv8, that can be implemented in real-time and with a limited resource base.

pmc-13206593.title: Unplanned Healthcare Utilization After Emergency Laparotomy: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13206593.creator: Lív í Soylu, Maria Vestergaard, Talha Malik, Jakob Burcharth, Dunja Kokotovic
pmc-13206593.description: BackgroundReadmissions following emergency laparotomy are frequent, and mainly a result of late‐onset postoperative complications, worsening of pre‐existing comorbidities, and non‐compliance with care instructions. This review aimed to describe current evidence on readmission after emergency laparotomy.MethodsA systematic search was performed in MEDLINE, Embase, and the Cochrane Library.

pmc-13390162.title: New Species and a New Record of the Genus Hydropunctaria from South Korea, with an Updated Key to All Known Species
pmc-13390162.creator: Jizhen Jin, Santosh Joshi, Jae-Seoun Hur
pmc-13390162.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Hydropunctaria (Verrucariaceae, Ascomycota) is currently circumscribed by 11 species, of which four are known from Asia. The taxonomy and species limits of this genus remain insufficiently understood, particularly in East Asia. Phylogenetic study based on three loci (ITS, mtSSU, and LSU) from populations collected at several localities in South Korea revealed the presence of a hitherto unrecognized species, here described as new species, Hydropunctaria fluminicola sp. nov., collected from fresh water regimes near the littoral zone.

pmc-13607091.title: Coronary Microvascular Dysfunction: Pathophysiology, Clinical Phenotypes, and Mechanism-Guided Diagnostic Strategies
pmc-13607091.creator: Divyansh Sharma, Daniel Bishev, Shudipan Chakraborty, Michael V. DiCaro, Ryan Shao, KiBuom Lee, KaChon Lei, Omar Shah, Sanjay Malhotra, Chowdhury Ahsan
pmc-13607091.description: Coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMD) is a prevalent and clinically important cause of myocardial ischemia across the spectrum of coronary artery disease, including patients with angina and nonobstructive coronary arteries, persistent symptoms after revascularization, and acute coronary syndromes. Despite its prognostic significance, CMD remains underrecognized due to the limitations of angiography-centered evaluation and the heterogeneity of underlying biological mechanisms.
